author: Zegita
body:
Well I decided to create a tournament map - this is my first ever map created and to be fair I wanted to help Avicus' competitive community by helping out and creating a tournament map :).

Special thanks to: Bloodoh, Pokerface, ViceWatercolour for giving me some tips and some ideas. I appreciate you guys :)

Images: http://imgur.com/a/wWeIJ

The map is complete it just needs YML to finish it and it should be good :D. Give me some feedback tell me how it looks and stuff you know the drill it'll really help xD.

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
Even though I helped with this map, I don't think it really stands out as to what other tournament TDMs could be. It's void based, and doesn't have much land variation. I'd dare say it's flat and gameplay could stalemate, but the points of the spawners aren't very strategically placed and it will most likely end up in either a stalemate, or a knockback war. The blocks don't mash well enough together aestetically, and the islands need to be beefed up.

I'm not really going to vouch for the map, but if improvements are made and it is solidified then I could see it in trial for testing.
